title: Loop Filter
text: Model second-, third-, or fourth-order passive loop filter, 1 input, 1 output, {Loop filter type} sets Order of the loop filter 3rd Order; {C1 (F)} sets the capacitance 1 14.5661e-15, {C2 (F)} sets the capacitance 2 160.276e-15, {C3 (F)} sets the capacitance 3 1.0452e-15, {C4 (F)} sets the capacitance 4 1e-12, {R2 (ohms)} sets the resistance 2 3.9955e6, {R3 (ohms)} sets the resistance 3 51.0435e6, {R4 (ohms)} sets the resistance 4 12e3, {Enable increased buffer size}, {Buffer size} sets the number of samples of the input buffering available during, {Enable impairments} adds circuit impairments to simulation and {Operating temperature (℃)} sets the temperature to determine the level of thermal. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Loop filter type
params.values: Order of the loop filter 3rd Order passive (default) | 2nd Order passive | 4th Order passive

params.name: Enable increased buffer size
params.values: Enable increased buffer size off (default) | on

params.name: Buffer size
params.values: Number of samples of the input buffering available during simulation 1000 (default) | positive integer scalar

params.name: Enable impairments
params.values: Add circuit impairments to simulation off (default) | on

params.name: Operating temperature (℃)
params.values: Temperature to determine the level of thermal noise 30 (default) | scalar
